4. Check version-control status and preserve unrelated user changes.

## Working rules

- Identify the requested outcome, constraints, and acceptance criteria before editing.
- Make the smallest coherent change; do not absorb unrelated cleanup.
- Never commit secrets, credentials, environment values, raw transcripts, or temporary artifacts.
- Add project-specific domain, architecture, and deployment constraints here only after verifying them.

## Completion

- Run fresh checks proportional to the change and read their exit status.
- Inspect the final diff and working-tree status for unrelated or generated changes.
- Report failures, skipped checks, limitations, and unverified behavior explicitly.
